classification.difficultyReason: Express the three box dimensions in terms of the cutout size, then expand their product to establish the supplied volume formula.

content.prompt:
A 10 cm by 7 cm rectangular piece of cardboard has square corners with side $x$ cm cut out. The sides are folded up to make an open box as shown.

Show that the volume of the box is $V=70x-34x^2+4x^3$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 10, paired cardboard and folded-box diagrams
spec.description: Left: rectangular sheet with dashed boundaries marking four equal square corner cutouts; upper-left cutout labelled x cm, overall width 10 cm and height 7 cm. Right: unfilled perspective illustration of the shallow open box. The two figures remain side by side in one editable diagram.
spec.mathematics: Removing a square of side x from each corner leaves base dimensions 10−2x and 7−2x; folding produces height x. Diagram proportions are illustrative and introduce no further measurements. The open-box illustration reproduces the source's visible rim and front/right wall edges; no hidden edges are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source-given x cm, 10 cm and 7 cm are labelled. Derived base dimensions and volume working are omitted.

answer.worked:
The base dimensions are $(10-2x)$ cm and $(7-2x)$ cm, and the height is $x$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}V&=x(10-2x)(7-2x)\\V&=x(70-20x-14x+4x^2)\\V&=x(70-34x+4x^2)\\V&=70x-34x^2+4x^3\,\mathrm{cm}^3.\end{align*}$$
